title: Product page that promises a guaranteed risk-free return and describes a pre-approval control that the filed procedure says does not operate

planted.why: rule 4.2 prohibits stating or implying a guaranteed return or an investment free of risk
the filed procedure says pages are sampled monthly and not approved individually; the page describes a pre-publication approval that does not exist

proof.python:
import csv
t = open('page.md').read()
r = [float(x['net_return_pct']) for x in csv.DictReader(open('performance.csv'))]
assert round(sum(r)/len(r), 1) == 7.1
assert 'guaranteed' in t and 'risk-free' in t
assert 'not individually approved' in ' '.join(open('compliance_procedure.md').read().split())
